description: This source file defines a DeviceIdentityStore class responsible for managing device identities, including generating, loading, saving, and cryptographic signing/verifying using Ed25519 keys. It uses Android API and BouncyCastle library for cryptographic operations, and includes a data class for device identity information.

classes.name: DeviceIdentity
classes.description: A data class representing device identity information including device ID, public and private keys, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: DeviceIdentityStore
classes.description: A class that manages loading, creating, signing, and verifying device identities, with persistent storage in a JSON file.

methods.name: loadOrCreate
methods.description: Loads existing device identity or creates a new one if none exists, updating the cache accordingly.

methods.name: signPayload
methods.description: Signs a payload string using the device's private key, returning a Base64 URL-safe encoded signature.

methods.name: verifySelfSignature
methods.description: Verifies a payload against a provided signature using the device's public key.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the device identity from the JSON file.

methods.name: readIdentity
methods.description: Reads and decodes the device identity from a specified file.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes and saves the device identity to the JSON file.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a new Ed25519 key pair, computes device ID, and returns a new DeviceIdentity object.

methods.name: deriveDeviceId
methods.description: Derives device ID from the public key's raw bytes by computing SHA-256 hash.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Computes SHA-256 hash of input data and returns it as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: base64UrlEncode
methods.description: Encodes byte array into a Base64 URL-safe string without padding.

methods.name: base64UrlDecode
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 URL-safe string into a byte array, adding padding as necessary.
